description: Run a golden-set retrieval eval against a specific vector_index_snapshot partition. Asset check fails on regression vs the prior materialization or below an absolute floor.

outputs.description: One row per golden query: query, expected_terms, top_k_docs, matched_terms, score

snapshot_root_dir.label: Snapshot Root Dir
snapshot_root_dir.description: Same directory as the upstream vector_index_snapshot writes to

min_score_threshold.label: Min Score Threshold
min_score_threshold.description: Absolute floor; asset check fails below this

regression_pct_threshold.label: Regression Pct Threshold
regression_pct_threshold.description: Max allowed drop vs prior materialization in percentage points
